about_the_game:
The Oddsparks: An Automation Adventure - Supporter Pack includes optional cosmetic content for our biggest fans.

This DLC offers some exclusive customization and decoration items and is meant for players who really like the game and want to express their support.
These are ALL the items included in the pack:

Royal Outfit:
  • Royal Cape (Top)
  • Royal Trousers (Bottom)
  • Royal Skirt (Bottom)
  • Royal Boots (Shoes)
  • Royal Brooch (Brooch)
  • Supporter Crown (Head Decoration)
  • Royal Staff (Staff)

Corrupted Aether Outfit:
  • Corrupted Aether Cape (Top)
  • Corrupted Aether Shorts (Bottom)
  • Corrupted Aether Slippers (Shoes)
  • Corrupted Aether Brooch (Brooch)
  • Corrupted Aether Head Decoration (Head Decoration)

Decorative golden statues of all Sparks:
  • Arty Spark Statue
  • Boomy Spark Statue
  • Burning Spark Statue
  • Carry Spark Statue
  • Choppy Spark Statue
  • Crafty Spark Statue
  • Crashy Spark Statue
  • Drilly Spark Statue
  • Freezing Spark Statue
  • Handy Spark Statue
  • Hauling Spark Statue
  • Loamy Spark Statue
  • Puffy Spark Statue
  • Rocky Spark Statue
  • Scouty Spark Statue
  • Scrubby Spark Statue
  • Slashy Spark Statue
  • Stumpy Spark Statue

The new outfit items for the most part have a predefined color scheme and can be used in the character editor right from the beginning.

The statues can be accessed as soon as you unlock the build menu during the tutorial.

Important: The main purpose of this DLC is to show your support for the game, the developer (Massive Miniteam), and the publisher (HandyGames). The items listed above are just a bonus to thank you for your continued support.
